name: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad al-Tawwazī
summary: Basran master of the lexicon, pupil of Abū ʿUbayda and al-Aṣmaʿī, who read Sībawayh's Book with al-Jarmī; al-Mubarrad knew no one more learned in poetry.
bio: Al-Tawwazī learned from Abū ʿUbayda and al-Aṣmaʿī and read the Book of Sībawayh with Abū ʿUmar al-Jarmī. Al-Mubarrad said he had seen no one more learned in poetry; al-Ushnāndānī was his pupil.
Al-Zubaydī counts him in the seventh generation of the grammarians of Basra. He died in 238/852.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 232–233
